doc.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25

title: Bailey's stick-juggling showmanship
summary: Bailey describes juggling sticks, hanging a cymbal from the ceiling and soloing on bass drum.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: You're juggling acting at the same time.

When I played in South Sea down in a few clubs I'd have my cymbal hanging up in the ceiling. Reach up in here. And then people would say I'd tell them I was drumming and go here can't I partner? Yeah it's good. Pretty good. I had a more holler last night. They said play Dave though. You didn't tell me that's a dream. I got on this solo. It was too bad boy. What number was this?
You tell me your dream I tell you mine.
That's his crib level you know he solos on the bass drum. I solo on the bass drum.
Of course I can solo on but I make it better on that one. And I cut loose and they say go on here. I don't know if they're going to do that.
